title: Bandra–Worli Sea Link at night
author: yatriksheth
attribution_text: Photo: yatriksheth · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons
notes: The cable-stayed towers of the Bandra–Worli Sea Link lit at blue hour, the deck lights reflected in the bay and city towers seen under the viaduct. Coordinates: landmark sea_link (cities/mumbai/landmarks.json); the Commons file has no camera location.

title: Monsoon rainwater at Apollo Bunder
author: Debjyotiarr
attribution_text: Photo: Debjyotiarr · CC BY-SA 3.0 · Wikimedia Commons
notes: Rainwater standing on the cobbled Apollo Bunder waterfront on a monsoon night (July 2013), street lights and the Taj Mahal Palace hotel reflected in it; people in the middle distance are small and unrecognisable. No free-licensed photo of a flooded Mumbai road with vehicles wading was found on Commons at a usable size, so this is the closest honest stand-in. Original 4928x3264; downloaded Wikimedia 3840 px rendition. Cropped to 16:9 with a 1.15x tighter window (horizontal anchor 1.0, vertical 0.15), which leaves out a group of people in the left foreground; resized; metadata stripped. Coordinates: city centre (cities/mumbai/city.json); a generic subject, never matched by distance.
